name: Trader Joe's Mandarin Orange Chicken (Deep-Fried Batter & Citrus Warning)
whyItWorks: Trader Joe's most famous item consists of dark-meat chicken chunks heavily battered and deep-fried, tossed in a sweet-and-sour sauce made with orange juice, vinegar, garlic, and dried chili. The combination of fryer oil, citrus acid, and alliums frequently sparks severe heartburn and diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Flare Warning: Avoid during active disease. If eating in remission, bake in an oven without frying and use only a tiny splash of the sauce packet (or substitute sweet soy sauce).
watchOuts: Violates citrus-free guardrail; heavy frying oil and acidic citrus glaze irritate inflamed intestines.
